rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-24 STEERABLE/ROTATION-EQUIVARIANT FoE (iso-param 1,921). Pivot away from training-efficiency (iters 21-23 settled: pretrain FROZE x2; ordered-subsets NO speedup, hr 0.2401<iter-7). Attack HEADROOM-PER-PARAM at same ~8-ep coupled training. FAILURE MODE: iter-7 24 FREE 7x7 analysis kernels are orientation-blind -> must spend separate weights on each rotated copy. CHANGE (ONE knob, analysis-filter parameterization): reg_type foe->steerable_foe; each filter K_f=sum_b c_fb*B_b over a SHARED FIXED steerable basis (n_rad=7 Gaussian radial profiles x circular-harmonic orders 0..3 -> Nb=49 = complete 7x7 frame). Span closed under rotation -> rotation-steerable by construction. OPTION (a) ISO-PARAM: nf24*Nb49=1,176 analysis (BYTE-IDENTICAL to iter-7 free) + 24*31=744 rbf + 1 alpha = 1,921 TOTAL exactly; basis atoms FIXED buffers (0 trainable). STABILITY: zero-init rbf (foe_rbf_init_std=0.0) -> reg(x)=0 at init (verified =0.0); coeff_std 0.05 over L2-normed atoms -> eff kernel element std 0.0496~iter-7; K=5, single tied scalar alpha, plain Adam peak lr 5e-3 PARTIAL cosine T_max=16, grad_clip=1.0, bs=1, per-sample-ps, full-view DC -- all iter-7 byte-for-byte; only the analysis frame changes (free 49-vector -> 49 steerable coeffs). HYPOTHESIS: equivariance gives more denoising power per param -> val-RMSE<7.40e-4 at same params/training -> hr>0.2515. NULL (hr~0.2515) cleanly says the free 7x7 bank was already near-optimal per param. PREDICTED val hr ~0.25-0.28. DEAD ENDS NOT reintroduced: pretrain, ordered-subsets, capacity^, K>5, momentum/per-step-alpha, learned-init, peak LR>5e-3, constant LR, full anneal to 1e-5, bilateral-alone., reg_type=steerable_foe, n_iter=5, learnable_alpha=True, per_step_alpha=False, momentum=False, cnn_channels=12, cnn_layers=3, alpha_init=0.1, clip_max=0.05, epochs=16, cosine_lr=True, cosine_lr_min=1e-05, lr=0.005, max_train_s=1080, train_n=200, foe_n_filters=24, foe_kernel=7, foe_n_bumps=31, foe_rbf_init_std=0.0, foe_filter_init_std=0.05, foe_x_range=1.0, steer_n_rad=7, steer_max_order=3, steer_coeff_init_std=0.05, two_phase=False, train_view_subset=1, learned_init=False, cosine_t_max=16, warmup_frac=0.0, weight_decay=0.0
